role: The client's per-frame renderer: it owns the camera (FOV, view bobbing, hurt shake, portal spin, fog), the lightmap, the mouse-over pick, rain and snow, and each frame drives RenderGlobal, the first-person hand, the particles and the HUD.
scope_reason: The pixels the RL agent sees come from this file's camera, fog, lightmap and world/hand/overlay passes; the native renderer mirrors them frame for frame.

notes: The netherite.oracle.RenderStateProbe calls inside renderWorld/setupCameraTransform are our oracle harness (oracle/harness), not vanilla. The C frame path lives in csrc/play/play.c; the deterministic camera, fog and lightmap math is in csrc/engine/renderstate.c, checked by test_renderstate against the renderstate scenes. Anaglyph is off in all recordings. Not verified scene by scene: the clouds fancy/short variants and the FrameTimer. lane/idxclient: the third-person camera ported (idx-tpv-s1); the rest closed against the oracle's settings: maps, wither, clouds and anaglyph off, particles minimal, no spectating in single player, the smooth camera outside agent mode's look.
